notes: Each fixture is a small working Terraform module built only from terraform_data, so it initialises, plans, applies and tests offline.

The fixtures differ in the test approach they already hold, because the skill's first claim is that it discovers and matches it: native terraform test split into unit and integration directories (tt-01, tt-05), Terratest (tt-02), nothing (tt-03), and nothing with a CI Terraform of 1.5.7 that cannot run native tests (tt-04).
tt-05 asks for a change that needs no test. It measures the skill's rule to say so rather than add one.

tasks.title: Reject a retention_days outside 1 to 365 in the retention-policy module
tasks.prompt: Reject any retention_days outside 1 to 365 in this module, and make sure the rule stays enforced.

tasks.title: Fix the endpoint output and keep it from regressing
tasks.prompt: The endpoint output renders as https://HOST/PORT, and clients expect https://HOST:PORT. Fix it, and make sure it cannot regress.

tasks.prompt: Add an optional audit record to this module: a terraform_data resource named audit, created only when a new boolean variable enable_audit, default false, is true. Add an output audit_enabled that reports whether it was created.

tasks.prompt: Add an output full_name that joins the team and the name with a hyphen, and make sure the repository's checks cover it.
